quarterly_data.quarter: GE Vernova press release: NRC issues first U.S. construction permit for a BWRX-300 (09-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: BWRX-300 licensing: the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission issued the Tennessee Valley Authority (TVA) a construction permit for a BWRX-300 small modular reactor at its Clinch River site in Oak Ridge, Tennessee - the first U.S. permit for a BWRX-300 (TVA applied in April 2025). Elsewhere: at OPG's Darlington New Nuclear Project, nuclear construction of the first BWRX-300 is underway and OPG submitted its License to Operate application for the first unit in March 2026 (under CNSC review); in September 2026 Blue Energy submitted the first part of its NRC construction permit application for a BWRX-300 in its Texas gas-plus-nuclear project. GE Vernova Power CEO Eric Gray: 'we work to support the deployment of the first BWRX-300 in the country'; GVH CEO Jason Cooper: 'Clinch River brings us another step closer to making that fleet model a reality'. The BWRX-300 is a 300-MW small modular reactor.
quarterly_data.figure: first U.S. BWRX-300 construction permit (TVA Clinch River); OPG License to Operate application March 2026; BWRX-300 300 MW
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: construction permit holder for the Clinch River BWRX-300 project
